why: This script produced the only surviving separation in the corpus: duration-matched knee gap 2.0899552309869094 deg, n=11 weakness vs 6 spastic, exhaustive floor 1/12376. If it carried an inverted or silently-excluding membership test, the paper has nothing.
METHOD: INSTRUMENTED AND COUNTED, not read. The two membership sites were re-executed with counters on every branch and the results reconciled against the deposited endpoint.

a_what_is_compared.line_94_dirs_for: tags is a list[str]; b = os.path.basename(dir).split('.')[0], i.e. the text before the FIRST period in the directory name -- e.g. 'R291KV0035_s101'. String against list-of-strings, same construction on both sides, so no type/case/whitespace mismatch is possible: b is derived by the identical expression that built every entry.
a_what_is_compared.line_107_weakness_tags: Same expression for the r287/r291 families, BUT the r276/r285 families are seeded by literal f-string construction '%s_s%d' rather than from disk. Those literals are compared against disk-derived strings. They matched: total tags 83 equals the deposit's n_weakness_total 83.
a_what_is_compared.line_120: b = [allv[i] for i in range(len(allv)) if i not in comb] -- an INTEGER INDEX complement inside the permutation, not a membership filter over cells. Checked, benign.

b_what_happens_to_a_failing_cell: Nothing is excluded from the ARM. 'if b not in tags' is a DEDUPLICATION guard: on failure the tag is simply not appended a second time. The cell remains present exactly once. It does not land in an excluded set and does not enter any denominator twice. Nothing is silently skipped.

c_COUNTS.why_zero: Both non-appended entries are the ' (1)' DUPLICATE DIRECTORIES of cells whose tag is ALREADY in the list. The cell is represented; only the second directory for that same cell is not added again. No cell is lost. Which of the two directories is then measured is decided downstream by rd()'s >=91-history-line guard, which selects the complete run.
c_COUNTS.neither_deduped_cell_is_in_band: R291BF005_s156 and R291BF005_s163 belong to the f=0.05 family, whose cells all end at 20.00 s and none of which is in the band. In-band weakness cells are: R276WPF005_s101, R285BF008_s105, R287BF007_s109, R291BF007_s162, R291BF007_s165, R291BF008_s152, R291BF008_s155, R291BF008_s158, R291BF008_s160, R291BF008_s163, R291BF008_s166

RECONCILIATION_EXACT.verdict: n=11 and n=6 reproduced EXACTLY. No reconciliation was required.

d_CONDITION_UNDER_WHICH_THIS_SCRIPT_STAR: The dropped set is EMPTY today. It becomes non-empty if two DISTINCT cells ever yield the same tag, because the second is then silently discarded as a duplicate. Since the tag is the text before the FIRST PERIOD of the directory name, that occurs if (1) a family prefix or seed token ever contains a period, truncating two different cells to one tag, or (2) a cell is re-run under a DIFFERENT lesion or objective into a directory sharing the same prefix_sSEED stem -- the tag cannot distinguish them, and the deduplication would keep only the first while the >=91 guard would then face two admissible directories and raise. Condition (2) is the live risk: it is exactly the R294FAST_s102 situation, where both twins cleared the generation guard. That arm is not touched by this script, which is why this script is safe TODAY and not safe BY CONSTRUCTION.
VERDICT: NO INVERSION. NO SILENT EXCLUSION. The separation stands as deposited.
